connector.name: MetaTrader 5 MCP Bridge
connector.registryDescription: Let an AI agent read and trade a MetaTrader 5 account over MCP, behind a human-approval gate.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mt5-trading-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vincentwongso account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MT5_LOGIN
env.description: MetaTrader 5 account number. Optional: overrides the config file and an already-logged-in terminal.

env.name: MT5_PASSWORD
env.description: MetaTrader 5 account password. Env-only so it never lands in a config file. Optional when the terminal is already logged in.

env.name: MT5_SERVER
env.description: MetaTrader 5 broker/trade server name. Optional: overrides the config file and an already-logged-in terminal.
